subject: Merchantly demo — paused as prospect reallocates Q3 sprint (reschedule later)
body:
From: Ben Watkins <ben@merchantly.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@merchantly.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Merchantly — demo request (proof of concept for recommendation reranking)

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the intro last week. We had a quick internal sync and would like to schedule a 45-minute technical demo focused on inference cost/latency tradeoffs and model rollout strategies for our recommendation reranker. Ideal window: next Tuesday or Wednesday morning PT. Goal is to validate whether Redwood can meet our 50ms p50 target and run reliably at our expected QPS.

Couple of artifacts attached: a short RFI and our Q3 roadmap snippet so you can see the broader context.

Best,
Ben
Senior Product Manager
Merchantly

Attachments: Merchantly_RFI_2026.pdf (application/pdf), Merchantly_Q3_Roadmap.png (image/png)

---
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Watkins <ben@merchantly.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@merchantly.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Merchantly — demo request (proof of concept for recommendation reranking)

Hi Ben — thanks for the RFI and roadmap. Happy to run a targeted session that focuses on latency SLOs, batching behavior, and canary rollout patterns.

I checked with Aditya (serving runtime lead) and Marissa (solutions engineer) — we have availability next
- Tue 14 Sep, 10:00–10:45 PT
- Wed 15 Sep, 09:30–10:15 PT

If either works I’ll send a calendar invite with an agenda: 1) short architecture & perf overview (10 min), 2) live demo showing p50/p95 under your QPS profile (20 min), 3) Q&A & next steps (15 min).

Also flagged the RFI items we’ll prep for in the demo (SOC 2 scope, data residency, expected token counts).

Regards,
Naomi Feldman
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
naomi@redwoodinference.com

---
From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@merchantly.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Watkins <ben@merchantly.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Merchantly — demo request (proof of concept for recommendation reranking)

Hi Naomi — quick update from our side. We just finished our weekly product planning and there’s been a change: the recommendation reranker work has been deprioritized for Q3 because our analytics team needs to finish a re-platform migration. The migration will consume the engineering bandwidth we planned to use for the POC.

Can we park the demo for now and look at rescheduling in early Q4? We still want to see Redwood’s performance profile but need to avoid pulling engineers into something we can’t staff.

Apologies for the short notice — would you mind keeping the thread open and we’ll circle back with an expected 2–3 week window for re-evaluating?

Thanks,
Sarah
Product Ops Manager
Merchantly

---
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@merchantly.com>, Ben Watkins <ben@merchantly.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Merchantly — demo request (proof of concept for recommendation reranking)

Hi Sarah / Ben — thanks for the update and for flagging the roadmap change — totally understood.

Quick notes from our side:
- We’ll mark the scheduled slot as tentative and remove the calendar hold for now.
- Aditya, Marissa and I will prepare a short one-pager (performance + cost checklist) you can review asynchronously while you reorganize. This should help the analytics team make a quicker assessment without a synchronous demo.
- If useful, we can also provide a short recorded demo (15 min) that shows p50/p95 under a simulated load that mirrors the numbers you provided in the RFI.

Action items:
- Naomi to share checklist + recorded demo link by Fri 18 Sep.
- Merchantly to confirm a Q4 week to resurface the demo (target early Oct).

If anything changes sooner, feel free to loop us back in. We’ll leave the HubSpot deal open but move the next-stage timeline out by one quarter to reflect the shift.

Appreciate the heads up — we’ll make it low friction for your team in the meantime.

Best,
Naomi
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
